from pathlib import Path
path = Path('src/data/lyrics/zainab-ke-bin-hain-ke-mere-ghar-ki-khir-ho.md')
original = path.read_bytes()
header, rest = original.split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
_, source = rest.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)
roman = \"\"\"1
Zainab ke bain haiṅ ke mere ghar ki khair ho
Mere ghar ki khair ho
Sholoṅ ki zad meiṅ Abid-e-Muztar ki khair ho
Muztar ki khair ho

2
Sholoṅ ki zad meiṅ aakhiri khaima bhi aa gaya
Khaima bhi aa gaya
Parwardigaar nasl-e-Payambar ki khair ho
Payambar ki khair ho

3
Taapoṅ ke darmiyaan Hasan ka hai laadla
Hasan ka hai laadla
Farwa tere hasin gul-e-tar ki khair ho
Gul-e-tar ki khair ho

4
Naize ke phal ne tor diya hai jawaaṅ ka dil
Haaye jawaaṅ ka dil
Ham surat-e-Nabi Ali Akbar ki khair ho
Ali Akbar ki khair ho

5
Dariya pe so gaya hai mere ghar ka paasbaan
Mere ghar ka paasbaan
Parwardigaar ab meri chaadar ki khair ho
Chaadar ki khair ho

6
Ghoron ki ek fauj sajaate haiṅ ashqiyaa
Sajaate haiṅ ashqiyaa
Maalik mere gharib baraadar ki khair ho
Baraadar ki khair ho

7
Naize chubho rahe hai laeeṅ regzaraa meiṅ
Laeeṅ regzaar meiṅ
Maango dua ke laasha-e-Asghar ki khair ho
Asghar ki khair ho

8
Yeh soch ke luta diya ghar Haq ki raah meiṅ
Ghar Haq ki raah meiṅ
Din-e-Nabi ki Kaaba-e-Athar ki khair ho
Athar ki khair ho

9
Shimr-e-sitam shuaar ki kaanoṅ pe hai nazar
Kaanoṅ pe hai nazar
Nanhi si jaaṅ yatima-e-Sarwar ki khair ho
Sarwar ki khair ho

10
Zainab duaaeṅ karti haiṅ majlis meiṅ ae Fasil
Majlis meiṅ ae Fasil
Har ek sogwaar ke har ghar ki khair ho
Har ghar ki khair ho
Zainab ke bain hai ke mere ghar ki khair ho\"\"\"
source_stanzas = source.decode().strip().split('\\n\\n')
roman_stanzas = roman.split('\\n\\n')
assert len(source_stanzas) == len(roman_stanzas) == 10
for number, (source_stanza, roman_stanza) in enumerate(zip(source_stanzas, roman_stanzas), 1):
    source_lines = source_stanza.splitlines()
    roman_lines = roman_stanza.splitlines()
    assert int(source_lines[0]) == int(roman_lines[0]) == number
    assert len(source_lines) == len(roman_lines)
assert sum(len(stanza.splitlines()) - 1 for stanza in roman_stanzas) == 41
assert all(char.isascii() or char == 'ṅ' for char in roman)
block = '\\n'.join('  ' + line if line else '' for line in roman.splitlines())
path.write_bytes(header + b'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + block.encode() + b'\\n---\\n' + source)
PY"

item.text:
Audited all 41 Urdu verses and aligned the Roman transliteration across all 10 stanzas. Removed recitation repeats absent from the source, restored missing source lines, and corrected Roman spelling, nasal markers, and punctuation. The Urdu text and other metadata were preserved.

Stanza 7’s `ریگزرا` remains an editorial uncertainty. The Roman `regzaraa` follows the written form. Human editorial sign-off is pending.
